title: Embedding + Reranker: Offline recall/precision and drift guardrails for config/model changes
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Scope: Build an automated offline evaluation and drift-detection pipeline that runs on every model/config change that could affect embedding/reranker quality. The goal is to surface regressions (recall/precision drops) or dataset drift before changes reach production and to integrate gating/alerts into CI and the Redwood Console. This ticket covers design, metrics, dataset selection, CI integration, dashboarding, and alerting playbook.

Why now: We've seen subtle regressions when switching quantization profiles and when routing to smaller reranker variants. These regressions don't always show up in token-level SLOs but materially affect downstream retrieval and ranking-based features. A lightweight offline harness will catch these earlier with lower cost than full functional tests.

Non-goals: Real-time online drift streaming (separate project), large-scale human evals, or building new retraining pipelines. This ticket focuses on offline recall/precision checks and statistical drift detectors tied to model/config changes.
acceptance_criteria:
1) CI runs a deterministic offline eval on a representative benchmark whenever a model binary, quantization profile, or reranker config is changed.
2) Eval computes P@k and Recall@k for the embedding+retriever baseline and NDCG for reranker outputs; thresholds are configurable per dataset.
3) Any metric regression beyond threshold fails the change in CI (block or flag depending on severity) and creates an alert in Console with links to diffs and artifacts.
4) Drift detectors (population vector drift + embedding distribution shift via MMD and cosine delta) run on a snapshot of production-ish data; alerts classify drift as low/medium/high.
5) Dashboards show trend history, recent CI runs, and top failing queries.
6) Documentation + runbook added to Confluence with mitigation steps and ownership.
tasks: Define representative offline benchmark datasets and per-dataset thresholds
Implement evaluation harness (py/evals) to score embeddings & reranker outputs deterministically
Add drift detectors: cosine centroid delta, MMD, and per-feature KS tests
Instrument CI to run the harness on PRs affecting models/configs and surface results in PR checks
Create Console dashboard + alerting pipeline linking CI failures to customer-impact tags
Write mitigation runbook and escalation policy
Add telemetry events for failed PRs and suppressed regressions for later review
